summary: Commits no longer fail with a false "another administrator" message, and the permission check stops raising false alarms.

fixes.title: Commits no longer blame another administrator
fixes.text: When the engine's own work changed rows under you, Commit was refused and you had to reload. It now re-applies your edits and commits, asking only when your rows really changed.

fixes.title: Correct Azure result in the permission check
fixes.text: The permission check on Overview now reads the Azure roles the engine actually holds, including inherited ones, so it no longer reports a false blocker.

fixes.title: Mail status in the permission check
fixes.text: Mail now counts as working when the latest real alert was delivered, and failing when the latest attempt failed, instead of always "not verified".
